customDictPrivacyWarning.comment: Privacy warning against storing sensitive personal data in the custom dictionary.

values.hanji: 請毋通佇自訂詞庫囥敏感 ê 個人資料，親像身分證字號、口座密碼、信用卡號碼，請注意家己 ê 資訊安全。
values.tailo: tshiánn m̄-thang tī tsū tīng sû khòo khǹg bín-kám ê kò-jîn-tsu-liāu， tshin-tshiūnn sin-hūn-tsìng jī-hō、 kháu-tsō bi̍t-bé、 sìn-iōng-khah hō-bé， tshiánn tsù-ì ka-kī ê tsu-sìn an-tsuân。
values.poj: chhiáⁿ m̄-thang tī chū tēng sû khò͘ khǹg bín-kám ê kò-jîn-chu-liāu， chhin-chhiūⁿ sin-hūn-chèng jī-hō、 kháu-chō bi̍t-bé、 sìn-iōng-khah hō-bé， chhiáⁿ chù-ì ka-kī ê chu-sìn an-choân。
values.en: Please do not store sensitive personal data in the custom dictionary, such as ID numbers, account passwords, or credit-card numbers. Mind your information security.
values.ja: 個人情報保護のため、カスタム辞書には機密性の高い個人データ（身分証番号、口座のパスワード、クレジットカード番号など）を保存しないでください。情報セキュリティにご注意ください。

values.hanji: 拍開了後，齒盤會記錄你揀過 ê 詞幾擺，予候選詞排序做參考，定定揀 ê 詞就會排較頭前，按呢候選詞就會愈來愈準。
values.tailo: phah-khui liáu-āu， khí-puânn huē kì-lio̍k lí kíng kuè ê sû kuí-pái， hōo hāu-suán sû pâi-sī tsuè tsham-khó， tiānn-tiānn kíng ê sû tsiū huē pâi khah thâu-tsîng， án-ne hāu-suán sû tsiū huē jú-lâi-jú tsún。
values.poj: phah-khui liáu-āu， khí-pôaⁿ hōe kì-lio̍k lí kéng kòe ê sû kúi-pái， hō͘ hāu-soán sû pâi-sī chòe chham-khó， tiāⁿ-tiāⁿ kéng ê sû chiū hōe pâi khah thâu-chêng， án-ne hāu-soán sû chiū hōe jú-lâi-jú chún。
values.en: When on, the keyboard records how often you pick each word and uses it to rank candidates. Words you choose often move toward the front, so the candidates get more accurate over time.
values.ja: オンにすると、各単語を選んだ回数をキーボードが記録し、候補の並び替えに利用します。よく選ぶ単語が前に移動し、候補が次第に正確になります。

associationManagement.comment: Page/section title for word-association record management.

associationRecordingEnabled.comment: Toggle label: enable recording of word-association (bigram) data.

associationRecordingEnabledInfo.comment: Info-dialog body explaining what association recording does for next-word prediction.

values.hanji: 拍開了後，齒盤會記錄頭前、後壁 ê 關聯詞，予連紲建議愈來愈準。
values.tailo: phah-khui liáu-āu， khí-puânn huē kì-lio̍k thâu-tsîng、 āu-piah ê kuan-liân sû， hōo liân-suà kiàn-gī jú-lâi-jú tsún。
values.poj: phah-khui liáu-āu， khí-pôaⁿ hōe kì-lio̍k thâu-chêng、 āu-piah ê koan-liân sû， hō͘ liân-sòa kiàn-gī jú-lâi-jú chún。
values.en: When on, the keyboard records which words follow which, making continuous suggestions more accurate over time.
values.ja: オンにすると、どの単語の後にどの単語が続くかをキーボードが記録し、連続入力の予測が次第に正確になります。

frequencyPrivacyWarning.comment: Privacy warning about sharing word-frequency data for research.

values.hanji: 詞頻紀錄對台語研究來講是真有價值 ê 資料。若欲提供予人研究訓練模型，請先刪除敏感 ê 私人資料。紀錄功能嘛會使關起來，毋過按呢候選詞 ê 排序就會較無準。
values.tailo: sû pîn kì-lio̍k tuì tâi-gí gián-kiù lâi kóng sī tsin ū-kè ta̍t ê tsu-liāu。 nā-beh thê-kiong hōo-lâng gián-kiù hùn-liān bôo-hîng， tshiánn sian san-tî bín-kám ê su-jîn tsu-liāu。 kì-lio̍k kong-lîng mā ē-sái kuainn--khí-lâi， m̄-koh án-ne hāu-suán sû ê pâi-sī tsiū huē khah bô tsún。
values.poj: sû pîn kì-lio̍k tùi tâi-gí gián-kiù lâi kóng sī chin ū-kè ta̍t ê chu-liāu。 nā-beh thê-kiong hō͘-lâng gián-kiù hùn-liān bô͘-hêng， chhiáⁿ sian san-tî bín-kám ê su-jîn chu-liāu。 kì-lio̍k kong-lêng mā ē-sái koaiⁿ--khí-lâi， m̄-koh án-ne hāu-soán sû ê pâi-sī chiū hōe khah bô chún。
values.en: Frequency records are valuable data for Taiwanese-language research. If you share them for research or model training, please delete sensitive private data first. You can also turn recording off, though candidate ranking will then be less accurate.
values.ja: 単語頻度の記録は台湾語研究にとって貴重なデータです。研究やモデル学習のために提供する場合は、機密性の高い個人データを先に削除してください。記録機能はオフにもできますが、その場合は候補の並び替えの精度が下がります。

values.ja: すべての単語頻度の記録を削除

associationPrivacyWarning.comment: Privacy warning about sharing word-association data for research.

values.hanji: 詞關聯紀錄對台語研究來講是真有價值 ê 資料。若欲提供予人做研究，請先刪除敏感 ê 內容。紀錄功能嘛會使關起來，毋過後一詞預測會較無準。
values.tailo: sû kuan-liân kì-lio̍k tuì tâi-gí gián-kiù lâi kóng sī tsin ū-kè ta̍t ê tsu-liāu。 nā-beh thê-kiong hōo-lâng tsuè gián-kiù， tshiánn sian san-tî bín-kám ê luē-iông。 kì-lio̍k kong-lîng mā ē-sái kuainn--khí-lâi， m̄-koh āu tsi̍t sû ī-tshik huē khah bô tsún。
values.poj: sû koan-liân kì-lio̍k tùi tâi-gí gián-kiù lâi kóng sī chin ū-kè ta̍t ê chu-liāu。 nā-beh thê-kiong hō͘-lâng chòe gián-kiù， chhiáⁿ sian san-tî bín-kám ê lōe-iông。 kì-lio̍k kong-lêng mā ē-sái koaiⁿ--khí-lâi， m̄-koh āu chi̍t sû ī-chhek hōe khah bô chún。
values.en: Association records are valuable data for Taiwanese-language research. If you share them for research, please delete sensitive content first. You can also turn recording off, though next-word prediction will then be less accurate.
values.ja: 単語連携の記録は台湾語研究にとって貴重なデータです。研究のために提供する場合は、機密性の高い内容を先に削除してください。記録機能はオフにもできますが、その場合は次の単語の予測精度が下がります。

values.ja: バックアップファイルにはすべての利用記録が含まれ、iOS と Android の両方で使用できます。機種変更の際もご安心ください。

moeDescription.comment: MOE Sutian dictionary — long description shown under its toggle in dictionary settings.

values.hanji: 提供臺灣台語搜尋及華語搜尋，可聆聽詞目和例句發音，方便學習。附有分類索引、部首筆劃索引及附錄。
values.tailo: Thê-kiong Tâi-uân tâi-gí tshiau-tshuê ki̍p huâ-gí tshiau-tshuê, khó lîng-thìng sû-ba̍k hàn lē-kù huat-im, hong-piān ha̍k-si̍p. Hù-ū hun-luī sik-ín、pōo-siú pit-uē sik-ín ki̍p hù-lio̍k.
values.poj: Thê-kiong Tâi-oân tâi-gí chhiau-chhôe ki̍p hôa-gí chhiau-chhôe, khó lêng-thèng sû-ba̍k hàn lē-kù hoat-im, hong-piān ha̍k-si̍p. Hù-ū hun-lūi sek-ín、pō͘-siú pit-ōe sek-ín ki̍p hù-lio̍k.
values.en: Search Taiwanese Taigi and Mandarin, with audio for headwords and example sentences for easy learning. Includes category and radical-stroke indexes plus appendices.
values.ja: 台湾語と中国語で検索でき、見出し語と例文の発音を聞いて学習できます。分類索引・部首画数索引・付録付き。

newwordDescription.comment: Taigi TV new-words dictionary — toggle description in dictionary settings.

values.hanji: 台語台邀請專家學者，定期召開會議，討論新興詞彙的適當台語講法，建立詞庫予民眾查詢使用。
values.tailo: Tâi-gí-tâi iau-tshiánn tsuan-ka ha̍k-tsiá, tīng-kî tiàu-khui huē-gī, thó-lūn sin-hing sû-luī ê si̍t-tong tâi-gí kóng-huat, kiàn-li̍p sû-khòo hōo bîn-tsiòng tsa-sûn sú-iōng.
values.poj: Tâi-gí-tâi iau-chhiáⁿ choan-ka ha̍k-chiá, tēng-kî tiàu-khui hōe-gī, thó-lūn sin-heng sû-lūi ê si̍t-tong tâi-gí kóng-hoat, kiàn-li̍p sû-khò͘ hō͘ bîn-chiòng cha-sûn sú-iōng.
values.en: Taigi TV invites experts and scholars to meet regularly, settle fitting Taigi terms for emerging words, and build a public lookup glossary.
values.ja: 台語テレビ局が専門家・学者を招き、定期的に会議を開いて新語の適切な台湾語表現を検討し、一般向けの検索辞書を構築しています。

sttiDescription.comment: MOE academic-terminology (STTI) dictionary — toggle description in dictionary settings.

values.hanji: 於106 年起進行語文、數學、社會、自然科學、藝術、綜合活動、科技、健康與體育等8大領域學科術語之台語編譯。
values.tailo: Tī 106 nî khí tsìn-hîng gí-bûn、sòo-ha̍k、siā-huē、tsū-jiân kho-ha̍k、gē-su̍t、tsong-ha̍p ua̍h-tōng、kho-ki、kiān-khong kap thé-io̍k tíng 8 tāi líng-i̍k ha̍k-kho su̍t-gí tsī tâi-gí pian-i̍k.
values.poj: Tī 106 nî khí chìn-hêng gí-bûn、sò͘-ha̍k、siā-hōe、chū-jiân kho-ha̍k、gē-su̍t、chong-ha̍p oa̍h-tōng、kho-ki、kiān-khong kap thé-io̍k téng 8 tāi léng-e̍k ha̍k-kho su̍t-gí chī tâi-gí pian-e̍k.
values.en: Since 2017, academic terminology across eight fields — language arts, mathematics, social studies, natural science, arts, integrative activities, technology, and health & physical education — translated into Taigi.
values.ja: 2017年から、国語・数学・社会・自然科学・芸術・総合的活動・科学技術・保健体育の8領域の学科用語を台湾語に翻訳。

kunggeDescription.comment: Craft-terms (Kungge) dictionary — toggle description in dictionary settings.

values.hanji: 收錄多達一千兩百組關鍵台語工藝詞彙，涵蓋陶瓷、木藝、金工、竹藤、纖維、玻璃、漆藝、石藝、皮革、紙藝等十一項工藝類別。
values.tailo: Siu-lio̍k to-ta̍t it-tshian nn̄g-pah tsoo kuan-kiān tâi-gí kang-gē sû-luī, hâm-kài tô-tsû、bo̍k-gē、kim-kang、tik-tîn、siam-uî、po-lê、tshat-gē、tsio̍h-gē、phuê-kik、tsuá-gē tíng tsa̍p-it hāng kang-gē luī-pia̍t.
values.poj: Siu-lio̍k to-ta̍t it-chhian nn̄g-pah cho͘ koan-kiān tâi-gí kang-gē sû-lūi, hâm-kài tô-chû、bo̍k-gē、kim-kang、tek-tîn、siam-ûi、po-lê、chhat-gē、chio̍h-gē、phôe-kek、chóa-gē téng cha̍p-it hāng kang-gē lūi-pia̍t.
values.en: Over 1,200 key Taigi craft terms covering eleven categories such as ceramics, woodcraft, metalwork, bamboo and rattan, fiber, glass, lacquer, stonework, leather, and paper craft.
values.ja: 陶磁・木工・金工・竹藤・繊維・ガラス・漆芸・石工・皮革・紙工など11分野にわたる、1,200組を超える台湾語の工芸用語を収録。

values.poj: Lí Kang Khioh tâi-gí bûn-kàu ki-kim-hōe hàn-lô ha̍p-iōng kiàn-gī iōng-jī.
values.en: Suggested Han-Roman mixed-script characters from the Lí Kang-Khioh Taigi Culture and Education Foundation.
values.ja: 李江却台語文教基金会による漢字ローマ字混在表記の推奨用字。

values.en: Government branches, common given names, 台/臺 variants, dictionary trivia, numbers/times/dates, and administrative districts.
values.ja: 一府五院、よくある名前、台/臺、辞典の豆知識、数字・時間・日付、行政区。

values.poj: Chi̍t-ê kûn-chiòng pian-chi̍p ê khai-hòng tâi-gí sû-tián
values.ja: みんなで編集するオープンな台湾語辞典。

values.poj: Ji̍t-pún sî-tāi Siáu-chhoan Siōng-gī pian-chhoàn ê tâi-gí sû-tián.

values.tailo: 「Tâi-huâ suànn-tíng sû-tián」sī Tīng Liông-uí kàu-siū thê-kiong tsu-liāu、Iûnn Ín-giân kàu-siū pian-siu
values.poj: 「Tâi-hôa sòaⁿ-téng sû-tián」sī Tēng Liông-úi kàu-siū thê-kiong chu-liāu、Iûⁿ Ín-giân kàu-siū pian-siu
